bio: Braith was born and raised on Viridia, a jungle island south of the Emerald Kingdom – and she is very much a product of her homeland. Full of life, but deadly dangerous, Braith is a master of lost Eldrin vine-magic, which she wields without hesitation in defense of her homeland.
